from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile, assemble, Aer, execute, QuantumRegister, ClassicalRegister
from qiskit.algorithms import QAOA
from qiskit.optimization.initial_points import UniformSampler
from qiskit.visualization import plot_histogram

    graph.add_nodes_from(vertices)
    graph.add_weighted_edges_from(edges)

    # Initialize QAOA parameters
    num_qubits = len(vertices)
    p = 1
    q = num_qubits - 1

    # Create QuantumCircuit and bind parameters
    qc = QuantumCircuit(num_qubits, num_qubits)
    for i in range(num_qubits):
        qc.h(i)
    qc = qc.assign_parameters({f' Beth{p}:{i}': graph[i]['weight'] for i in range(num_qubits)})

    def qaoa_operator(beta, gamma):
        qc.barrier()
        for i in range(p):
            for j in range(i + 1, q):
                cnot_gate = QuantumCircuit(*[i, j])
                cnot_gate.cx(i, j)
                qc.append(cnot_gate, [f' Beth{i}', f' Beth{j}'])
        return qc

    problem = dimod.QuadraticModel()
    for i in range(num_qubits):
        problem.add_linear_constraint(dimod.BinaryVar(i), 1)
        for j in range(i + 1, num_qubits):
            problem.add_quadratic_constraint(i, j, -1, 1)

    # Run QAOA
    algo = QAOA(qaoa_operator, problem, initial_point_generator=UniformSampler(num_samples=100), max_iter=10)
    result = algo.run(num_shots=1000)

    # Extract optimal beta, gamma values

    gamma_opt = result.optima[1]
